lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a structured grid pattern posterior to the gills, consisting of roughly five discernible horizontal rows and at least twelve vertical columns of varying spot diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, particularly in the central flank region, intersecting with circular spots to form a grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light pixels on the superior edge and shadow-induced lower-intensity pixels on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, deep V-shaped notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, elongated, low-luminance object is positioned immediately adjacent to the posterior notch of the pectoral fin.
